ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 92:8 ratio of low-intensity black/dark grey pixels to high-intensity white/light grey pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous dark-intensity field across both lobes. Distinct high-intensity (white) clusters at the extreme distal tips. Fine-line high-intensity pixel disruptions scattered across the central and right medial regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a pixel-measured internal angle of approximately 42 degrees, bisecting the two lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude irregular serrations at distal tips. Medial edges show lower-amplitude, irregular micro-serrations with a notable jagged indentation on the right lobe trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex sweep from the median notch to the distal tips on both the left and right lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly localized, high-density clusters of high-contrast white pixel rosettes at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes, indicating heavy barnacle colonization.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous thin, high-contrast linear streaks (rake marks) visible; a set of parallel diagonal lines is prominent on the lower right lobe surface, and vertical streaks are present near the median notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular indentation on the trailing edge of the right lobe; dense biological colonization (barnacles) at both distal tips.
other_distinctive_markers: Parallel orientation of multiple rake marks on the ventral surface of the right lobe.
